w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: The Focus Group stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: You read its weight, its breath, the set of its shoulders. It's winding up Rerun — lands next beat. (Read Stance — pattern known.)
firstContext: Big Big is shaking it off.
Too close. The tiger's attention SNAPS to you — proximity overrules patience.

You focus — that costs your action.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Big Big is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
They come fast and scared — a family, or what's left of one. "Please. We heard you take people in." Behind them, something worse than weather.

SYSTEM: Identification complete. You are 0.3% less lost.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (21/12/7), with 7 wave-4 and 1 wave-5 fought, 6 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 6 · Forage 14 · Craft 7 · Talk 12 · Explore 33 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

firenarr.line: ⚠ The store keeps slipping from its recent high again — evening after evening, lower.
⚠ The store has fallen further still from its recent high.
⚠ The store has fallen far from its recent high again — the shelves are nearly bare.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,063 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
It wants the job itself: caretaking, as a practice. This is the ask the whole ladder was climbing toward.
